connectors.name: Left edge pads
connectors.orderNote: No printed position numbers; started at end closest to USB connector (top). Label = port name (PAxx); silkscreen pin name first in functions.

connectors.name: Right edge pads
connectors.orderNote: No printed position numbers; started at end closest to USB connector (top). Six pads visible on the board photo.

connectors.name: SWD pads (inset)
connectors.orderNote: Inset shows four pads in a horizontal row with leader lines; no USB in inset, so ordered left to right.

uncertain: The right-side label stack begins with a RESET / CONTROL row level with D1, but the board photo shows no pad at that position (only the mounting hole and the reset button). It was not transcribed as a pad on right-header; it may belong to an unseen pad or to the reset button.
SWD inset leader lines: mapping read as leftmost pad = SWDIO, then SWCLK, GND, RESET; the lines are small and the mapping is inferred from where each vertical line turns.
notes: The D13 / LED / PA10 / A4 label stack below the board points at the D13 LED, not a pad; skipped per rule 1. Qwiic connector pins are not individually labeled; skipped. Duplicate repeated names (e.g. pin name D1 and Arduino D1, SCL in both pin-name and serial columns) kept once.
